answer: An adversary running 72 aliases thus needs 114 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in garden, expire in wharf, and haven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3577 identities would post 1807 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
